declarations.docstring: The short complex formed by the degree-zero differential and the terminal map is exact.
The Koszul complex is exact at each positive successor degree.
Every object of the Koszul complex is projective.
The range of the differential in degree `i + 1` equals the kernel of the differential in degree `i`.
The range of the degree-zero differential equals the kernel of the terminal map.
The augmentation from the Koszul complex to the complex concentrated in degree zero.
The degree-zero component of the Koszul-complex augmentation is the displayed module morphism.
The Koszul-complex augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism.
The projective resolution obtained from the Koszul complex and its augmentation.
A projective resolution constructed when the module is finite dimensional over a field.
The complex underlying the Koszul projective resolution is the Koszul complex.
Each term of the Koszul projective resolution is a free module.
The augmentation of the Koszul projective resolution is the Koszul-complex augmentation.
The displayed term of the Koszul complex is a free module.
